title: Juice N Power Middle East Sour Cherry Nic Salt E-Liquid
description: Middle East Sour Cherry from Juice N Power delivers an irresistible Cherry flavour with none of the cloying candy flavour often found in cherry e-liquids. Authentic, tangy and absolutely moreish. This premium e-liquid’s 50VG/50PG blend offers the perfect balance between flavour and cloud production and the nicotine salt solution makes it ideal for use in classic e-cigarette starter vape kits and pod vape devices. Perfect for recent ex-smokers or vapers seeking the immediate, satisfying nicotine relief provided by nic salts with a super-smooth throat hit.
